corrections.why: The county and its seat are spelled Nacogdoches. The Central US Lookouts page reads 'Nacogdoches County' and quotes the 1949 NGS description with NACOGDOCHES; the FFLA list and this record carry a misspelling.

corrections.proposed: agency: none recorded; the sentence belongs in status_note
corrections.why: On the Central US Lookouts page the sentence sits in the page header as a condition note. It names no managing agency.

notes_for_editor: The 1949 description is the copy reproduced on the Central US Lookouts page. The current NGS record for BY2683 is a nonpublication listing with no datasheet, so the 1949 text could not be checked against NGS directly. The listing gives two entries: XX (X = surface mark reported destroyed) and NN (N = no geodetic control); the story reports both codes and does not choose. The FFLA coordinates match the NGS listing (31 32 30 N, 094 42 20 W). The 110-foot height is converted to 33.5 m here. No removal date, photo, or access note was found. The FFLA list spells the county 'Nacagdoches', and the record copied that spelling; both the correction and the story use Nacogdoches. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the NGS listing lines read XX and NN (horizontal and vertical nonpublication codes), so the story gives those two-letter codes and defines X and N. The Forest Service tower-building background is attributed to the Texas column, which does not name Fern Lake; no source ties this tower to that program.
